intro: Answer before any pixel is measured. Your answers decide the branch, the steps and the outputs. The agent may PROPOSE answers; only you set answered_by = "user".

questions.help: drawing = a measured plan (JPEG / PNG / PDF render) — traced pixel for pixel. sketch = a photo of a hand scribble — derived from its dimension chain, not traced.

questions.ask: One level, or several sheets that stack?

questions.help: user: you give px/m (or a measured span) — the agent only cross-checks it against printed sizes in ONE line. agent: least-squares from every printed room size.

questions.ask: If you set the scale: pixels per metre on the source image
Place the symbols drawn on the sheet (fixtures, furniture)?
questions.help: all = every drawn symbol is placed or listed as not placed (objects are mandatory). Furnishing EMPTY rooms is Design-phase work, not tracing.

questions.ask: Sketch: enforce hall and kitchen larger than every bedroom?
